reports.title: Sales & revenue reports
reports.description: Understand sales, cash received, and the costs behind your shop’s performance.
reports.demo: Demo report · Uses your local orders and a small sample financial ledger. These are not real transactions. Sample activity: 6–12 October 2026.
reports.periodHint: Inclusive calendar dates in Asia/Tehran. Today is a partial day. Comparison uses the immediately preceding, equal number of whole calendar days. Month presets and displayed dates use the Persian calendar.
reports.invalidRange: Choose an end date on or after the start date, within a 10-year range.
reports.storageUnavailable: Local order storage could not be read. This report may omit saved orders.

definitions.gross: Paid, non-cancelled orders created in this period; item prices before adjustments, excluding shipping.
definitions.net: Gross sales less recorded item discounts and refunds. Missing adjustment records are disclosed below.
definitions.payments: Recorded receipts confirmed in this period, including shipping. Independent of order creation and invoice status.
definitions.profit: Gross profit less other expenses. Unavailable when cost snapshots, adjustments or expense coverage are incomplete.
definitions.orders: Orders created in this period, currently marked paid, excluding recorded cancellations.
definitions.average: Net sales divided by valid orders in the same creation-date cohort.

reports.trendHint: Sales use creation dates; receipts use confirmation dates. Partial first/last buckets are included.
reports.createdHint: Orders created within the selected period, grouped by their current status.
reports.tryRange: Choose another reporting period to explore your shop’s activity.
reports.productsHint: Variants are aggregated into their parent product. Known COGS includes only units with historical cost snapshots; gross profit requires complete costs and adjustments.
reports.noProducts: No valid product sales in this period
reports.cancellationHint: Cohort cancellations count created orders now cancelled; cancellation events use the cancellation timestamp. The current order model has no cancellation status or history.
reports.statusHint: Amounts are item subtotals before adjustments, excluding shipping; this breakdown includes unpaid orders.
reports.rules: Sales: paid orders, excluding recorded cancellations. Net sales = gross − discounts − refunds. COGS = eligible quantity × historical unit acquisition cost. Gross profit = net sales − COGS. Estimated net profit = gross profit − other expenses. Sales exclude shipping.
reports.adjustmentHint: Adjustments belong to the original order cohort and reflect currently recorded totals, not refund cash-flow dates. Missing adjustment records mean provisional net sales. Refunds do not reverse inventory costs without a recorded return.
reports.missingCosts: Some eligible units have no historical acquisition-cost snapshot. Known COGS is partial; total COGS, gross profit and estimated net profit are unavailable.
reports.missingExpenses: Expense coverage is incomplete. Recorded expenses are shown, but estimated profit is unavailable.
reports.missingPayments: Only explicitly timestamped sample receipts are included. Confirmed payments are partial; a paid flag alone does not provide a receipt date.
reports.missingAdjustments: Some orders have no adjustment records. Their recorded gross amount is used provisionally; discounts and refunds may be missing.
reports.missingCancellations: Cancellation history is unavailable; cancellation counts and rate are not reported as zero.
reports.expensesHint: Inventory purchases and inbound acquisition costs belong to inventory, excluded from other expenses to avoid deducting COGS twice. Shipping expenses here mean delivery to customers. Expense dates use Tehran time.
reports.noExpenses: No expense records in this period; this does not establish zero expenses.
reports.printHint: Choose “Save as PDF” in your browser’s print dialog. Check the preview before saving.
reports.coverageHint: {known, number} of {total, number} eligible units have a known cost. Explicit zero costs are included; missing snapshots are never replaced with current product costs.
reports.coverageExplanation: Known-cost sold quantity / all eligible sold quantity × 100. No eligible units = unavailable. Known COGS is a partial sum when coverage is below 100%. Missing costs are not zero.
reports.zeroExpenses: No operating expenses in this period (complete records).

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your shop and document defaults. Business settings are saved only in this browser; they are not synced to a server.

descriptions.shop: One shop identity for the sidebar, new invoices, customer pages and shipping labels.
descriptions.invoices: Customize the text captured on newly issued invoices.
descriptions.shipping: Choose the dispatch contact and default physical label size.
descriptions.reports: Choose the starting view when you next open Reports.
descriptions.appearance: Personal display preferences using the existing theme and language controls.

settings.contactHint: Contact details are optional here. Shipping labels require a valid phone and complete address, either here or in the dispatch override.
settings.snapshotHint: Shop name, logo and contact come from Shop profile. Changes apply only to new invoices. Existing invoice snapshots, order prices and costs stay unchanged.
settings.shippingHint: The shop name and logo always come from Shop profile. Use a separate dispatch contact only when parcels leave from a different location.
settings.useShopContact: Use shop contact details for dispatch
settings.defaultCompare: Compare with the previous equivalent period by default
settings.reportHint: Defaults apply when opening Reports. They do not change calculations, historical records or current report filters.
settings.appearanceHint: Changes apply immediately. Theme uses this browser’s existing preference; language follows the locale URL. These are personal preferences, not shop-wide settings.
settings.readError: Saved settings could not be read. Safe defaults are shown. Review and Save to replace this section, or retry after enabling browser storage.
settings.saveError: Settings were not saved. Check browser storage and try Save again. Your edits are retained.
settings.unsaved: Unsaved changes · drafts are retained when switching tabs
settings.leaveHint: Discard the unsaved changes in this section and leave?
settings.orderSettingsError: Shop or invoice settings could not be read. Open Settings and review the saved values before creating this order.
